design_axis: canonical Character identity/presence architecture beneath optional depiction
bounded_question: How can one persistent Character remain visually recoverable across scale, crop, context, accessibility reduction and optional depiction changes without one fixed portrait or image becoming identity authority?
controlled_inputs: identical synthetic Characters A/B/C and signatures 1-3-2 / 2-1-3 / 3-2-1
identical authoritative synthetic H1/H2/H3 history labels
A/B strongest relational focus while C remains fully specific
the ten frozen deterministic CPS-01 roles
neutral grayscale/value-first deterministic geometry and labels only
excluded_variables: CLR F2-versus-F1 adjudication or palette tokenization
final typeface, symbol, wordmark, material or motion selection
Stage pixel/geometry modification or reopening closed Stage gates
Phase C exit by CPS-01 alone

local_result.summary: Mechanical/accessibility preflight passes after neutral carrier repairs. Frozen-method Design Sol scoring leaves CPS-B and CPS-C as survivors; CPS-A requires targeted refinement. No canonical architecture is selected before Director adjudication.
local_result.recommended_incumbent: CPS-B — Design Sol recommendation pending Director adjudication
alternates: CPS-C — lawful survivor with context-dependency restraint
targeted_refinement_required: CPS-A — centralized kernel creates structural emblem/avatar pressure at MICRO/COMPACT scale

judgment.design_sol_view: Rank CPS-B first, CPS-C second, CPS-A third. Promote neither B nor C to canonical authority until the Director makes the consequential identity choice.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: PENDING — genuine consequential identity/taste decision remains between two lawful survivors.

visual: prototypes/cps-01/carrier.html — deterministic human-viewable architecture comparison surface
accessibility: normal 1440/320, 200% text 1440/320, forced-colors 1440/320, reduced-motion 1440; all zero unintended overflow

requires: Director adjudication between CPS-B and CPS-C before any canonical CPS incumbent is recorded

known_integration_sensitivities: CPS-B redundancy must remain sparse and must not become an inventory of decorative marks.
CPS-C context may shape composition but must never substitute for or mutate canonical identity.
CPS-A has not been rejected outright; it simply does not survive this consumed comparison and cannot be repaired inside the same gate after scoring.
Any representative real-app conflict is new integration evidence and must open a bounded successor/refinement gate rather than rewrite CPS-01 history.
explicit_non_authority: No canonical Character architecture selected before Director adjudication.
No final Character appearance, portrait system, generated artwork or renderer authorization.
No CLR choice, Stage modification, Phase-D entry, native/runtime/production authority or ODR resolution.

director_review_surface.what_to_review: Compare CPS-B Distributed Recognition Mesh against CPS-C Context-Persistent Presence Scaffold across the same ten roles; judge which should become the canonical Phase C Character-presence architecture.
